To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the presented tool chain supports the model-based development of embedded systems according to the DECOS architecture by providing a platform-independent model for capturing the resources and their interconnections of a DECOS hardware platform, a library of hardware building blocks for the rapid modeling of hardware platforms, and a tool chain for the generation of a platform-specific model and the simulation of the modeled hardware platform.

we have defined an MDA-compliant meta-model for the hardware platforms of the DECOS architecture and we have developed an Eclipse-based tool chain that supports the model-based development of distributed embedded applications.

the presented approach facilitates the development of distributed real-time systems based on the DECOS architecture by providing a platform-independent representation and a precise model of hardware platforms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a meta-model for the modeling of hardware platforms and the development of a tool chain for their efficient design and reuse.
the development of a meta-model and a tool chain that supports the modeling and validation of distributed embedded systems in the DECOS architecture by means of model-driven development.
the modeling of hardware platforms in order to enable model-driven development of distributed embedded real-time systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model-driven architecture is a promising paradigm for the development of distributed real-time embedded systems.
the DECOS architecture and its associated development methodology are well suited to support the development of complex distributed embedded systems.

the model-based development of embedded systems is an approach that has the potential to address the challenges in the design of distributed embedded systems, and the DECOS integrated platform architecture is a promising architecture for the development of such systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have defined the meta-model and tool chain for the DECOS architecture and we have validated it with a case study.
we developed a meta-model and tool support for modeling the hardware platform of the DECOS integrated platform architecture.
we have developed a meta-model for modeling hardware platforms of DECOS and we have developed a tool chain for modeling the hardware platform of DECOS.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the meta-model and tool chain are generic and can be used for the development of distributed real-time embedded systems in other architectures as well.
the meta-model can be used as a common ground for the development of a set of tools for the development of distributed applications on the DECOS architecture.
the model-driven approach is suitable for the development of distributed real-time and embedded systems.
